midnight.purpose: Primary action, Decide pill, selected chips, chart flags.

sky-2.purpose: Middle of the day sky; top of the soft sky.

haze.purpose: Canvas the sky fades into; sheets, dialogs, footers.

accent-bright.purpose: End-point dots, selection, icons on midnight.

rain.purpose: Second data colour, fill gradients, range band.

display.purpose: The single hero figure, set on the sky (Home uses 56px).

figure.purpose: Lead figure in a glass module; steps to 30px and 26px.

headline.purpose: Large screen title on the sky.

label.purpose: Name above a figure; form labels at 600.

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Every glass surface, with the glass-edge highlight.

shadows.name: glass-edge
shadows.purpose: Top highlight that replaces a border.

shadows.name: selected-ring
shadows.purpose: Selected card or option, with shadow-soft.

shadows.name: glass-blur
shadows.purpose: Glass modules; tab bar uses blur(24px) saturate(1.8), header blur(20px) saturate(1.6).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: House ease for presses, reveals, sheets and chart draws.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 0.7s, translateY(14px) and blur(4px) to rest, staggered 0.06s

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations and transitions to 0.01ms; clouds stop

breakpoints.name: device
breakpoints.purpose: Single iOS column inside the device frame; no responsive layout inside the app.

night.note: Dark appearance with starfield. Verified on Home and Decide only.

narrative.overview:
A money decision is a forecast, so the app lives under a real sky. The sky follows the time of day (morning gold and blue, clear day blue, evening lilac and rose, night navy with stars) and fades into a pale haze where the reading content begins. Headline figures sit directly on that sky with no container; only grouped, tappable content earns a surface, and that surface is borderless frosted glass so the sky keeps reading through it. Risk is spoken as a weather bulletin in four levels (ok, be aware, be prepared, take action), never as green up and red down decoration.

The world is calm, open and airy. Density is moderate: one strong figure per module, generous section breaks, and hairlines instead of boxes where a group only needs separating. One typeface (Figtree) carries everything from the 60px hero figure to the 10.5px tab label, with tight negative tracking on figures. Primary action is midnight ink; deep sky blue is the voice of selection and data; violet means estimate. The prototype is an iOS screen shown in a 440px device frame.

Retired and not to return: the earlier storm-teal tile world, Barlow numerals, isobar contour lines, blob art and dot grids. Boxed bento cards, bordered containers and a single neon fintech accent are rejected by this world.
keyCharacteristics: Time-of-day sky backdrop with drifting clouds on top-level screens, a softer sky on sub-screens.
Hero figures on the sky with no surface; everything else grouped on borderless frosted glass.
Four bulletin colours reserved for state.
Figtree only, tabular figures with tight tracking.
Phosphor icons: regular by default, fill when selected, duotone inside tinted badges.
Midnight pill for primary actions and for the Decide tab.

rules.name: The Bulletin Rule
rules.body: Ok green, aware amber, prepare orange and act red only ever mean state: a level chip, a negative delta, a shortfall, a destructive action, an error. They never colour a category, a decoration or a brand moment.

rules.name: The Midnight Acts Rule
rules.body: The filled primary action is midnight ink (white at night). Deep sky blue selects and charts; it does not fill primary buttons.

rules.name: The Violet Means Estimate Rule
rules.body: Violet tint marks assumed or estimated values and nothing else.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Figtree is the only typeface, including inside SVG illustrations and chart labels. No second display face, no mono.

rules.name: The Tight Figures Rule
rules.body: Every money figure is tabular and tracked negative (-0.03em to -0.045em, tighter as it grows). Sentence case everywhere; nothing is set in uppercase.

rules.name: The Open Sky Rule
rules.body: The first figure on a top-level screen sits directly on the sky: no surface, no radius, no shadow, just its label, the figure, a delta chip and an open chart.

rules.name: The No Border Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never take a stroke. Their edge is a 0.5px inset highlight and a soft shadow; selection is a 2px inset accent ring, and only inputs and secondary controls use a 0.5px inset hairline.

dos: Do put the hero figure directly on the sky with no container (no background, shadow or radius).
Do use borderless frosted glass (glass or glass-strong, 18px blur, glass-edge highlight, soft sky shadow) for every other module.
Do reserve ok, aware, prepare and act for state, and speak them through the level chip, deltas, shortfall shading and errors.
Do use midnight for the filled primary action and the Decide pill, inverted to white at night.
Do set every figure in Figtree 650 with tabular numerals and negative tracking.
Do use Phosphor icons only: regular idle, fill selected, duotone in tinted badges.
Do read sky colours from the sky tokens so morning, day, evening and night all work; verify night on any new screen.
donts: Don't bring back contour lines, isobars, blob art or dot grids, on the sky, in illustrations or behind charts.
Don't put a border or stroke on a surface; use the glass-edge highlight and soft shadow.
Don't box hero figures or arrange the overview as a grid of boxed bento cards.
Don't use the bulletin colours for categories, chart series, decoration or on/off switches.
Don't add a second typeface, a mono face or uppercase labels.
Don't use text glyphs (arrows, chevrons, check marks) as icons; use Phosphor.
Don't fill primary buttons with deep sky blue or introduce a neon accent.
